209: function biomeAt(x, z) {
210:   // Pseudo-random stable biome field based on world position.
211:   const nx = Math.floor(x / 22)

213:   let h = 2166136261

215:   h ^= nz; h = Math.imul(h, 16777619)
216:   const pick = (h >>> 0) % BIOMES.length
217:   return BIOMES[pick]
218: }
